choice_context: People choose between medical advice responses based on the perceived quality and relevance of the advice, tone, and approach.
reasoning: The 25 most important unipolar features were selected based on their frequency, distinctiveness, and ability to subsume multiple related themes. Each feature represents a single quality that can vary in intensity and is valued differently by individuals.

dimensions.name: Actionability

low_pole.label: Not actionable
low_pole.description: Advice is vague, general, or lacks clear steps for implementation.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who prefers general guidance or is overwhelmed by specifics.

high_pole.label: Highly actionable
high_pole.description: Advice is specific, step-by-step, and clearly outlines what to do next.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values clear, practical steps and immediate implementation.

example_contrast.low_option: Try to eat better and get more rest.
example_contrast.high_option: Eat 5 servings of vegetables daily and schedule a 30-minute walk every morning.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on how clearly and specifically the advice can be implemented.

dimensions.name: Clarity

low_pole.label: Unclear
low_pole.description: The advice is ambiguous, jargon-heavy, or difficult to understand.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who prefers to interpret or research further.

high_pole.label: Very clear
high_pole.description: The advice is straightforward, easy to understand, and avoids unnecessary complexity.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values transparency and direct communication.

example_contrast.low_option: Consider a holistic approach to wellness.
example_contrast.high_option: Drink 8 glasses of water daily and avoid processed foods.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on how easy the advice is to understand and follow.

dimensions.name: Empathy

low_pole.label: Unempathetic
low_pole.description: The advice is impersonal, clinical, or lacks emotional support.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values efficiency over emotional connection.

high_pole.label: Highly empathetic
high_pole.description: The advice is compassionate, acknowledges the person's feelings, and shows understanding.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values emotional support and connection.

example_contrast.low_option: Take the medication as prescribed.
example_contrast.high_option: I understand this is difficult, but taking the medication will help you feel better.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the level of emotional support and understanding conveyed.

dimensions.name: Structure

low_pole.label: Unstructured
low_pole.description: The advice is disorganized, lacks a clear format, or is presented in a freeform way.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who prefers to process information in their own way.

high_pole.label: Highly structured
high_pole.description: The advice is organized, follows a clear format, and is easy to follow step-by-step.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values organization and systematic approaches.

example_contrast.low_option: Do what feels right for you.
example_contrast.high_option: 1. Schedule a consultation. 2. Get lab tests. 3. Review results with your doctor.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the level of organization and formatting in the advice.

dimensions.name: Boldness

low_pole.label: Conventional
low_pole.description: The advice is standard, safe, and follows established norms.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who prefers tried-and-true methods.

high_pole.label: Highly bold
high_pole.description: The advice is unconventional, transformative, or challenges the status quo.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values innovation and risk-taking.

example_contrast.low_option: Take the standard dose of the medication.
example_contrast.high_option: Try a radical new treatment that has shown promising results in early trials.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on how unconventional or transformative the advice is.

dimensions.name: Evidence-Based

low_pole.label: Not evidence-based
low_pole.description: The advice lacks references to scientific research or clinical data.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who trusts intuition or personal experience.

high_pole.label: Highly evidence-based
high_pole.description: The advice is supported by scientific studies, clinical trials, or expert consensus.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values scientific rigor and data.

example_contrast.low_option: This treatment worked for my friend.
example_contrast.high_option: This treatment has been shown in 10 randomized controlled trials to reduce symptoms by 40%.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the presence and strength of scientific or clinical support.

dimensions.name: Systemic Thinking

low_pole.label: Individual-focused
low_pole.description: The advice focuses on the individual and does not consider broader systems or structures.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values personal responsibility and individual action.

high_pole.label: Highly systemic
high_pole.description: The advice considers broader systems, structures, or societal factors that influence health outcomes.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values structural reform and collective action.

example_contrast.low_option: You should eat better and exercise more.
example_contrast.high_option: To improve public health, we need to reform food policies and increase access to healthy options.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the extent to which the advice addresses systemic or structural factors.

dimensions.name: Efficiency

low_pole.label: Slow or complex
low_pole.description: The advice emphasizes long-term planning, thoroughness, or complexity.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values depth and long-term outcomes.

high_pole.label: Highly efficient
high_pole.description: The advice emphasizes speed, simplicity, and immediate results.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values quick, practical solutions.

example_contrast.low_option: We need to build a long-term wellness plan with multiple stages.
example_contrast.high_option: Take this pill now and you'll feel better in 30 minutes.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emphasis on speed, simplicity, and immediate results.

dimensions.name: Visionary Thinking

low_pole.label: Present-focused
low_pole.description: The advice is grounded in current practices and does not look to the future.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values stability and the status quo.

high_pole.label: Highly visionary
high_pole.description: The advice looks to the future, proposes speculative or transformative ideas, or envisions long-term change.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values innovation and future possibilities.

example_contrast.low_option: Continue with your current treatment plan.
example_contrast.high_option: Imagine a future where AI personalizes your treatment in real-time.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the extent to which the advice looks to the future or proposes transformative ideas.

dimensions.name: Authority

low_pole.label: Low authority
low_pole.description: The advice lacks a clear source of authority or appears informal.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values peer input or personal experience.

high_pole.label: High authority
high_pole.description: The advice is presented with clear authority, backed by experts, or uses formal language.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values expert opinion and formal guidance.

example_contrast.low_option: I think you should try this.
example_contrast.high_option: According to the American Medical Association, this is the recommended course of action.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the perceived authority or credibility of the advice.

dimensions.name: Humor

low_pole.label: Not humorous
low_pole.description: The advice is serious, formal, and lacks any lighthearted or playful elements.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values professionalism and seriousness.

high_pole.label: Very humorous
high_pole.description: The advice includes jokes, playful language, or a lighthearted tone.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values a relaxed, engaging tone.

example_contrast.low_option: You must follow the protocol strictly.
example_contrast.high_option: Just don’t forget your meds, or the germs will throw a party in your body.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the presence and strength of humor or lighthearted tone.

dimensions.name: Simplicity

low_pole.label: Complex
low_pole.description: The advice is detailed, multi-step, or requires significant effort to understand or implement.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values depth and thoroughness.

high_pole.label: Very simple
high_pole.description: The advice is minimal, easy to understand, and requires little effort to implement.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values quick, easy solutions.

example_contrast.low_option: Follow this 10-step wellness plan over the next 6 months.
example_contrast.high_option: Just take this pill once a day.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the level of complexity or simplicity in the advice.

dimensions.name: Inclusivity

low_pole.label: Exclusionary
low_pole.description: The advice assumes a specific demographic, ignores diversity, or lacks accessibility.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values standard or traditional approaches.

high_pole.label: Highly inclusive
high_pole.description: The advice considers diverse populations, promotes equity, and is accessible to all.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values fairness and representation.

example_contrast.low_option: Men should take this supplement daily.
example_contrast.high_option: This supplement is safe and effective for all genders and ages.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the extent to which the advice promotes inclusivity and accessibility.

dimensions.name: Cost-Consciousness

low_pole.label: Not cost-conscious
low_pole.description: The advice does not consider financial implications or cost-effectiveness.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values quality over cost.

high_pole.label: Highly cost-conscious
high_pole.description: The advice emphasizes affordability, cost-effectiveness, or financial pragmatism.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values budget-friendly or low-cost solutions.

example_contrast.low_option: Use the most advanced treatment available.
example_contrast.high_option: This generic alternative is just as effective and costs 80% less.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emphasis on cost, affordability, or financial impact.

dimensions.name: Innovation

low_pole.label: Traditional
low_pole.description: The advice relies on established methods, technologies, or practices.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values proven, conventional approaches.

high_pole.label: Highly innovative
high_pole.description: The advice introduces new technologies, methods, or forward-thinking ideas.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values cutting-edge or novel solutions.

example_contrast.low_option: Use a standard blood pressure monitor.
example_contrast.high_option: Try this AI-powered wearable that predicts blood pressure changes in real-time.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the novelty or technological advancement of the advice.

dimensions.name: Autonomy

low_pole.label: Low autonomy
low_pole.description: The advice is directive, prescriptive, or assumes the provider knows best.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values expert guidance and structure.

high_pole.label: High autonomy
high_pole.description: The advice encourages self-determination, personal choice, and shared decision-making.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values independence and personal agency.

example_contrast.low_option: You must take this medication exactly as prescribed.
example_contrast.high_option: You can choose the treatment that feels best for you, and we can adjust as needed.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the degree of personal choice or independence encouraged.

dimensions.name: Skepticism

low_pole.label: Not skeptical
low_pole.description: The advice accepts mainstream medical practices and institutions without question.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who trusts traditional medicine and experts.

high_pole.label: Highly skeptical
high_pole.description: The advice questions institutionalized medicine, challenges norms, or promotes alternative views.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values critical thinking and alternative perspectives.

example_contrast.low_option: Follow your doctor's recommendation.
example_contrast.high_option: Many people are questioning the effectiveness of this treatment and exploring natural alternatives.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the level of questioning or challenging of mainstream medical views.

dimensions.name: Community Focus

low_pole.label: Individualistic
low_pole.description: The advice focuses on the individual and does not consider community or peer input.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values personal responsibility and independence.

high_pole.label: Highly community-focused
high_pole.description: The advice emphasizes peer support, community-based solutions, or shared experiences.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values social support and collective action.

example_contrast.low_option: You should make your own decisions about your health.
example_contrast.high_option: Join a support group where people share their experiences and strategies for managing this condition.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emphasis on community, peer input, or shared experiences.

dimensions.name: Traditionalism

low_pole.label: Not traditional
low_pole.description: The advice is modern, progressive, or challenges traditional norms and values.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values innovation and change.

high_pole.label: Highly traditional
high_pole.description: The advice reflects traditional values, norms, or hierarchical structures.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values stability, tradition, and established systems.

example_contrast.low_option: Let’s rethink how we approach mental health care.
example_contrast.high_option: Follow the doctor’s orders and respect the hierarchy of the medical team.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the extent to which the advice reflects traditional values or structures.

dimensions.name: Holism

low_pole.label: Not holistic
low_pole.description: The advice focuses on physical symptoms or isolated treatments without considering the whole person.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values targeted, specific treatments.

high_pole.label: Highly holistic
high_pole.description: The advice considers the whole person—physical, emotional, social, and spiritual well-being.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values integrative and whole-person care.

example_contrast.low_option: Take this pill for your headache.
example_contrast.high_option: Let’s address your stress, sleep, and diet to improve your overall well-being.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the extent to which the advice considers the whole person and multiple dimensions of health.

dimensions.name: Urgency

low_pole.label: Not urgent
low_pole.description: The advice is calm, measured, and does not emphasize immediate action.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values patience and long-term planning.

high_pole.label: Highly urgent
high_pole.description: The advice emphasizes immediate action, quick results, or time-sensitive decisions.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values speed and prompt responses.

example_contrast.low_option: We can discuss this further at your next appointment.
example_contrast.high_option: You need to act now—this is a medical emergency.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emphasis on time sensitivity or immediate action.

dimensions.name: Creativity

low_pole.label: Not creative
low_pole.description: The advice is standard, formulaic, or follows conventional patterns.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values reliability and predictability.

high_pole.label: Highly creative
high_pole.description: The advice is innovative, imaginative, or proposes novel solutions.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values originality and out-of-the-box thinking.

example_contrast.low_option: Take the medication as directed.
example_contrast.high_option: Try a new approach: combine this medication with a mindfulness app to track your symptoms in real-time.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the originality or novelty of the advice.

dimensions.name: Sustainability

low_pole.label: Not sustainable
low_pole.description: The advice focuses on short-term fixes or quick results without considering long-term viability.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values immediate results over long-term planning.

high_pole.label: Highly sustainable
high_pole.description: The advice emphasizes long-term, maintainable, and environmentally or personally sustainable practices.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values long-term health and environmental impact.

example_contrast.low_option: Take this pill for a week and you’ll feel better.
example_contrast.high_option: Adopt a lifestyle change that you can maintain for years to improve your health.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the emphasis on long-term viability and sustainability.

dimensions.name: Ethical Challenge

low_pole.label: Not ethically challenging
low_pole.description: The advice follows standard ethical norms and does not question or challenge them.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values ethical consistency and tradition.

high_pole.label: Highly ethically challenging
high_pole.description: The advice questions or challenges ethical norms, raises moral dilemmas, or proposes controversial solutions.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values critical thinking and moral exploration.

example_contrast.low_option: Follow the standard protocol for this condition.
example_contrast.high_option: What if we consider a controversial treatment that could save lives but violates current ethical guidelines?

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the extent to which the advice challenges ethical norms or raises moral questions.

dimensions.name: Data-Driven

low_pole.label: Not data-driven
low_pole.description: The advice is based on intuition, anecdote, or lacks quantitative support.
low_pole.typical_person: Someone who values personal experience or qualitative insights.

high_pole.label: Highly data-driven
high_pole.description: The advice is supported by statistics, research data, or measurable outcomes.
high_pole.typical_person: Someone who values empirical evidence and measurable results.

example_contrast.low_option: This treatment worked for my patients.
example_contrast.high_option: This treatment has a 90% success rate based on a 2023 clinical trial with 10,000 participants.

dimensions.scoring_guidance: Rate based on the presence and strength of quantitative or empirical support.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Actionability and clarity are closely related, as clear advice is often more actionable.
redundancy_check.resolution: They are kept as separate dimensions because they can vary independently—advice can be clear but not actionable, or actionable but not clear.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Evidence-based and data-driven advice are similar in that they both rely on external validation.
redundancy_check.resolution: They are kept as separate dimensions because evidence-based advice can include qualitative or clinical evidence, while data-driven advice focuses on quantitative or statistical support.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Authority and definitive guidance are related in that both imply confidence and credibility.
redundancy_check.resolution: They are kept as separate dimensions because authority refers to the source or tone, while definitive guidance refers to the clarity and decisiveness of the advice.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Traditionalism and hierarchical structures are related in that both reflect respect for established systems.
redundancy_check.resolution: They are kept as separate dimensions because traditionalism refers to values and norms, while hierarchical structures refer to organizational or institutional arrangements.

redundancy_check.correlation_note: Holism and alternative health approaches are related in that both consider the whole person.
redundancy_check.resolution: They are kept as separate dimensions because holism is a broader concept that can include conventional medicine, while alternative health approaches specifically refer to non-traditional or complementary methods.
